rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
$\vec{a}\cdot\vec{b} = ab\cos\theta = a_1b_1 + a_2b_2 + a_3b_3$.
Angle between vectors: $\cos\theta = \frac{\vec{a}\cdot\vec{b}}{ab}$, and $\vec{a}\cdot\vec{b} = 0 \iff \vec{a} \perp \vec{b}$.
